name: vibe-canvas
description: A live right-side projection of the current Codex conversation, with source turns, structured understanding, and a dynamic mind map.

interface.shortDescription: Project each Codex turn into a live right-side mind map.
interface.longDescription: A local-first conversation projection for Codex: keep chatting normally on the left while AI auto-picks useful turns, merges repeated ideas into a typed concept graph, preserves cross-topic relations and manual Pick provenance, and expands third-level claims into exact fourth-level source evidence on demand.
defaultPrompt: 在右侧打开 Vibe Canvas 实时投影。
继续对话并自动更新我的思考画板。
